Alex: hey @people-ops — got the benefits welcome email but no health insurance ID card yet. is that mailed or should i see it in an app?
Jamie (People Ops): Hi Alex — welcome! Cards are mailed to the address HR has on file (7-10 business days). You should also be able to access a digital card via the insurer's app/web. If you don't see the setup link, DM me and i'll trigger a resend. :smile:
Alex: thanks. i don't see any link in the email. i'll DM you my address. also queued a question: i moved here for the role — is relocation reimbursement still handled through Expense?
Samir: yep, submit relocation receipts in Concur and tag the policy code REL-2025. People Ops approves then Finance processes — usually within 2 pay cycles. Keep in mind receipts need to be uploaded within 60 days of expense.
Alex: got it. quick payroll check — PayrollBot showed "direct deposit pending" earlier. any action needed?
PayrollBot: Direct deposit setup completed for employee 18123. Next payroll run will use provided bank info. If you need manual pay or a paper check for first cycle, notify payroll@redwood.ai before EOD Friday.
Alex: one more thing — PTO proration. i started on 2026-03-16. how many PTO days do i get this month?
Jamie (People Ops): For the first partial month we prorate based on calendar days. Formula we use: (annual allotment / 12) * (days employed in month / total days in month). Example for March: annual allotment 15 days -> monthly = 1.25. Employed 16 days of 31 -> prorated = 1.25 * (16/31) ≈ 0.65 days, which we round to nearest half-day on first month. If you'd like, i can run the exact calc for your hire date and confirm.
Alex: please run it and post the number here when you can, thanks! :pray:
Jamie (People Ops): Will do — running now. i'll post back in a minute.
Jamie (People Ops): Ok — for start date 2026-03-16 with 15 annual days: prorated PTO for March = 0.5 days (we round down to half-day for partial months). Your next full month accrual will show as 1.25 on 4/1.
Alex: perfect, appreciate it.
Jamie (People Ops): Also — if you need urgent doctor visits before the physical card arrives, the insurer will accept the digital member ID (screenshot from the app) or give the provider your member number. If provider asks for group/policy number, DM me and i'll pull it for you.
Alex: great, thanks again everyone :thumbsup:
Samir: welcome aboard! ping if you want a quick onboarding walkthrough for Concur.
Alex: would love that, maybe next week.
PayrollBot: Reminder: submit any one-time pay exceptions by close of business Tuesday to make the next payroll run.
Alex: noted.
